items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I have a brother, Enrique... But he make the mistake of being my friend too

ctx.x: Do you have other brothers and sisters?
I have a brother, Enrique which was born in 1950, and Rosario, which was born in 1961.
Where did you spend the majority of your childhood?
